Plex currently needs atlas (it runs as a Docker container there) and tank (library on tank/media, appdata on tank/appdata). The titan transcoding dependency is superseded history.

If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint (port 11434, direct dependent) stops, and through it the wiki-search service on hermes (second hop) degrades: new wiki pages are not embedded, but keyword search still works. Plex no longer depends on titan (old transcoding dependency is superseded).
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (the job runs there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot) and gate (internet access to upload to the offsite-crypt remote).
hermes needs atlas (the VM runs on atlas and stops when atlas stops) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains; it cannot boot without tank).

Syncing tank/notes to pebble stops. Syncthing directly depends on atlas (runs there), tank (syncs tank/notes) and tailscale (sync runs over Tailscale only); tank exists only while atlas runs, and tailscale also runs on atlas, so atlas stopping breaks the sync directly and via tank and tailscale.

Direct dependents of gate: aria (its network address and network features), the nightly rclone-backup (internet upload), the reverse-proxy (outside access via port 443 forward), tailscale (internet access) and atlas (Unraid email notifications). Second hop via tailscale: syncthing (sync to pebble) and pebble (remote access to hermes and Plex).

Directly it needs hermes (it runs there) and the ollama-endpoint on titan (embeddings only; without it new pages are not embedded but keyword search still works, so keyword queries need only hermes). Indirectly hermes needs atlas and tank (vdisk on tank/domains), tank needs atlas, and atlas needs apc-1 (power) and gate (notifications); the ollama-endpoint needs titan awake.

Direct dependents of atlas: host/VM hermes, pool tank, and services tailscale, syncthing, rclone-backup, plex and reverse-proxy. Second hop: wiki-search (needs hermes, which also needs tank) and pebble's remote access (via tailscale); syncthing and plex also need tank.

Direct dependents of tank: hermes (vdisk on tank/domains, cannot boot), plex (library and appdata), syncthing (tank/notes sync to pebble) and the nightly rclone-backup (05:45 snapshot). Through hermes, the wiki-search service also stops (second hop); tank itself exists only while atlas runs, so atlas staying up does not save these.

The wiki-search service (qmd) stops because it depends on hermes, and the nightly 02:30 index rebuild does not run so the search index goes stale. No other page depends on hermes; the planned second exit node on hermes is only pending.
